iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: Talairach coordinates as stated by the source readme_HighSamplingRate.txt.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Each row is the MIDPOINT of a bipolar channel ("Position: Talairach coordinates of the channels (midpoint of bipolar channels), in mm"). Coordinates copied unchanged from the source. region_id/region_name refer to the 17-region segmentation shipped with the HFO dataset (labels.nii).
iEEGCoordinateProcessingReference: Frauscher B et al. (2018) Ann Neurol 84:374-385, doi:10.1002/ana.25304
